decisions.modules: crates/larql-kv/tests/continuation_mem_1/: codec_2.rs (bank-2 authority, binding guards, guard A, the verdict), codec_2_stats.rs (pure statistics: SplitMix64, nearest-rank percentile, the paired McNemar bound, the stratified block bootstrap), codec_2_controls.rs (the known-answer controls), codec_2_run.rs (the resumable real run, ignored)
decisions.checkpoint_store: CODEC-1's checkpoint store is private to its frozen run module. Rather than widen a frozen module's visibility, codec_2_run.rs restates the same store (atomic temp-then-rename writes, an authority stamp that refuses a resume under other authorities, raw f32 LE logits with a trailing index). One copy is the price of keeping CODEC-1's code exactly as it ran
decisions.percentile: nearest-rank: sort ascending, rank = max(1, ceil(p · n)), value at rank − 1 — the definition of represent/bank.rs nearest_rank_percentile, which is pub(crate) in larql-vindex and not reachable from a test target. Restated in codec_2_stats.rs and pinned by a control that it equals metrics::summarise's kl_p99 on the same positions
decisions.splitmix64: state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z = state; z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) · 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) · 0x94D049BB133111EB; out = z ^ (z >> 31) (wrapping). Seed 0xC0DEC2 (frozen). Pinned by a control against the published first outputs for seed 0
decisions.bootstrap_draw: per replicate, rungs in ladder order 2,048 → 4,096 → 8,192, 32 draws each, block index = next_u64() mod 32 (modulo bias ≤ 32 / 2^64, stated not corrected). The replicate pools its 3,072 positions; its mean and nearest-rank p99 of d are recorded. Upper bound = nearest-rank 0.95 of the 10,000 replicate statistics. B2 and B3 read the SAME replicates
decisions.mcnemar: b = #(CH agrees, C does not), c = #(C agrees, CH does not); diff = (b − c)/n; se = sqrt(max(0, (b + c) − (b − c)²/n))/n; lower = diff − 1.6449 · se. With b + c = 0 the bound is 0 (no discordance, no evidence of loss)
decisions.verdict_order: guards first (bank, NULL per rung, bindings, residency regression, A); any guard failure → UNINFORMATIVE with no rule adjudicated. Then B1–B4: any adjudicated FAIL → NOT ACCEPTABLE; else B4 below N_MIN → UNINFORMATIVE; else ACCEPTABLE
decisions.bindings: C and CH: CODEC-1's yardstick_guard (decoder_stack → Q4_K, stored, rev 1). R, NULL and H: decoder_stack recorded as NOT a stored pack (stored: false) — the full-precision representation a plain open binds
decisions.arm_order_per_rung: R (logits kept) → NULL (guard) → C (logits kept) → CH → H; each a checkpoint
decisions.per_position_record: every scored arm's PositionMetrics against R, unchanged from CODEC-1's score(); plus, for CH, KL(C‖CH) per position from C's kept logits (reported, not adjudicated)
decisions.environment: LARQL_CODEC2_F32, LARQL_CODEC2_Q4K, LARQL_CODEC2_RUN_DIR — CODEC-1's variable names are not reused, so a CODEC-1 run directory cannot be mistaken for a CODEC-2 one (the authority stamp would also refuse it)
decisions.per_rung_report: the forecast says each rule is also reported per rung; each rung's thresholds (ε, the tail bound) come from THAT rung's C, and its bootstrap is the same stratified procedure over one stratum — the rules are relative to C, and each rung is a different passage. Per-rung outcomes are findings beside the pooled verdict, never the verdict

controls_planned.B1: hand-built agreement vectors with a closed-form lower bound; a pair built to sit just above −δ holds and one just below fails; b + c = 0 holds at 0
controls_planned.B4: the same bound restricted to margin ≥ 0.9; 349 band positions → UNINFORMATIVE regardless of agreement; 350 → adjudicated
controls_planned.bootstrap_reproducible: same seed → identical replicate statistics; a different seed → different ones
controls_planned.bootstrap_closed_form: constant d = k in every position → every replicate mean and p99 equal k, so both bounds equal k exactly
controls_planned.stratification: rungs of constant d = 0, 1, 2 → every replicate mean is exactly 1 (each rung contributes exactly 1,024 positions). NEGATIVE control: the same fixture under an unstratified sampler (96 blocks drawn freely) gives replicate means that vary — so the control can detect reweighting
controls_planned.guard_A: top-1 0.699 or KL mean 0.501 refuses; 0.70 and 0.50 admit
controls_planned.verdict: each tri-state path reached by a constructed case
controls_planned.percentile: equals metrics::summarise's kl_p99 on the same positions

closure.status: CLOSED 2026-09-30. This record is final; nothing in it changes after this entry.
closure.answer: No, not by the frozen margins. On the held-out bank, 4-bit codec/v1 stacked on the shipped Q4_K execution materially worsens that execution's agreement with the full-precision reference in the tail
